name: FilterTableOrRange
label: Filter Table or Range
description: Applies filter conditions to a table or range in the workbook.

fields.name: TenantId
fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.description: The Azure Active Directory tenant ID (GUID or domain name, e.g., contoso.onmicrosoft.com).

fields.name: ClientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Azure AD application (client) ID registered in your tenant.

fields.name: ClientSecret
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The client secret (password) of the Azure AD application used for authentication.

fields.name: DriveId
fields.label: Drive ID
fields.description: The unique identifier of the OneDrive or SharePoint document library drive.

fields.name: ItemId
fields.label: Item ID
fields.description: The unique identifier of the Excel file within the drive.

fields.name: RangeOrTable
fields.label: Table or Range
fields.description: The name of an Excel table (e.g., 'Table1') or a cell range address (e.g., 'A1:D100') to apply the filter on.

fields.name: Column
fields.label: Filter Column
fields.description: The column name (for tables) or column letter/number (for ranges) to filter by (e.g., 'Department' or 'B').

fields.name: Criteria
fields.label: Filter Criteria
fields.description: The value or condition to filter the column by (e.g., 'Sales', '>=100', or 'John*').
